name: public.sgp_produccion_reservas_v
definition:
WITH base AS (
         SELECT sp.key_produccion,
            sp.id,
            sp.id_linea,
            sp.produccion,
            COALESCE(sp.semana_actual, sp.semana_base) AS semana_produccion,
            sp.acabado AS acabado_produccion,
            COALESCE(( SELECT pr.reserva
                   FROM sgp_prioridades pr
                  WHERE pr.key_produccion = sp.key_produccion AND pr.id_linea = sp.id_linea AND pr.semana = COALESCE(sp.semana_actual, sp.semana_base)
                  ORDER BY pr.fecha_actualizacion DESC NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 1), NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM split_part(COALESCE(sp.reserva_al, ''::text), ','::text, 1)), ''::text)) AS reserva_principal,
            TRIM(BOTH FROM r.reserva) AS reserva
           FROM sgp_producciones sp
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(sp.reserva_al, ''::text), '\s*,\s*'::text) r(reserva)
          WHERE sp.activa = 'SI'::text AND NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM r.reserva), ''::text) IS NOT NULL
        ), dedup AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT base.key_produccion,
            base.id,
            base.id_linea,
            base.produccion,
            base.semana_produccion,
            base.acabado_produccion,
            base.reserva_principal,
            base.reserva
           FROM base
        ), enriched AS (
         SELECT d.key_produccion,
            d.id,
            d.id_linea,
            d.produccion,
            d.semana_produccion,
            d.acabado_produccion,
            d.reserva_principal,
            d.reserva,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY d.key_produccion) AS reservas_count,
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN d.reserva = d.reserva_principal THEN d.acabado_produccion
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END, ( SELECT
                        CASE
                            WHEN count(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sa.acabado), ''::text)) = 1 THEN min(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sa.acabado), ''::text))
                            ELSE NULL::text
                        END AS "case"
                   FROM sgp_seguimiento_aluminio sa
                  WHERE sa.reserva = d.reserva AND COALESCE(sa.semana_prog, sa.semana) = d.semana_produccion AND COALESCE(sa.activo, 'SI'::text) = 'SI'::text), ( SELECT
                        CASE
                            WHEN count(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sp2.acabado), ''::text)) = 1 THEN min(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sp2.acabado), ''::text))
                            ELSE NULL::text
                        END AS "case"
                   FROM sgp_prioridades pr2
                     JOIN sgp_producciones sp2 ON sp2.key_produccion = pr2.key_produccion
                  WHERE pr2.reserva = d.reserva AND pr2.semana = d.semana_produccion AND sp2.id_linea = d.id_linea AND sp2.activa = 'SI'::text), ( SELECT
                        CASE
                            WHEN count(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sa.acabado), ''::text)) = 1 THEN min(NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM sa.acabado), ''::text))
                            ELSE NULL::text
                        END AS "case"
                   FROM sgp_seguimiento_aluminio sa
                  WHERE sa.reserva = d.reserva AND COALESCE(sa.activo, 'SI'::text) = 'SI'::text)) AS acabado_reserva,
            COALESCE(( SELECT max(COALESCE(sa.semana_prog, sa.semana)) AS max
                   FROM sgp_seguimiento_aluminio sa
                  WHERE sa.reserva = d.reserva AND COALESCE(sa.activo, 'SI'::text) = 'SI'::text), ( SELECT max(pr2.semana) AS max
                   FROM sgp_prioridades pr2
                  WHERE pr2.reserva = d.reserva AND pr2.id_linea = d.id_linea), d.semana_produccion) AS semana_reserva
           FROM dedup d
        )
 SELECT key_produccion,
    id,
    id_linea,
    produccion,
    semana_produccion,
    reserva_principal,
    reserva,
        CASE
            WHEN reserva = reserva_principal THEN 'PRINCIPAL'::text
            ELSE 'ASOCIADA'::text
        END AS tipo_relacion,
    acabado_reserva,
    semana_reserva,
    sgp_es_reserva_compartida(key_produccion) AS es_reserva_compartida,
        CASE
            WHEN reserva <> reserva_principal THEN sgp_reserva_es_principal(reserva, id_linea, key_produccion)
            ELSE false
        END AS es_principal_compartida
   FROM enriched;
